descriptor or observed input hash is supplied here.

key-before-body, whole-file routine, planned two passes, failure stop and
closing-control loop remain unchanged. The frontier has 159 unchanged full
rows plus five old/new replacements, eight removed/eight added component
spellings, unchanged five complete membership guards, and an added eighth
closure gap. Its 164/204 cardinality is coincidental, not unchanged evidence.

Outer/driver dedicated stdin reads require a fresh O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|
O_NONBLOCK fd, a full expected key before the single current-position byte
read, return zero, and a same-fd after check. Ordinary snapshots dispatch
stdin through that helper; the driver's non-body-ancestor guard is preserved.

one-byte input is retained before refusal. Offset zero is expressly source-
derived from fresh open and the only zero-return read; actual_offset_query
is null, with no new lseek/fdinfo query. Node's Stats properties require a
separate received actual native-mask key and never prove 0xFFF support.

The collector adds a literal Bash redirection from that same pathname.
This early open stays inside the ordinary-trusted bootstrap assumption,
not pre-Bash/env/interpreter startup attestation. Outer and each native
child get separately freshly opened/verified later descriptors.

The inherited outer/probe full_stat error schema remains byte-identical;
it does not attach every native failure buffer. The observer still retains
its raw native events but does not guarantee retention of failed file-body
bytes. New helper record/close/transport failures can remain incomplete;
no all-path perfect-capture or continuous-race claim is made.
No lifecycle, no-retry/no-intervention, phase, body, runtime or external gate
was weakened. Source-only error/draft details remain preserved.
